newsitem.title: USA: Videonics sees higer revs, profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Videonics sees higer revs, profit in 1997.

text.p: Videonics Inc remains on track to increase revenues and return to profitability by the end of the year, Chief Financial Officer Jim McNeill said in a statement.

But he added the company's financial performance "will continue to be under pressure until additional new products begin shipping later this year." The company, which Monday reported a $0.42 per share loss and a steep drop in revenue in the first quarter, said results were hurt by lower orders for Videographer products and the late release of other new products, which minimized their contribution to the quarter.
Analyst estimates are for fiscal 1997 earnings to break even, according to First Call.
